title: acmella filipes var. parvifolia
intro: Acmella filipes var. parvifolia, commonly known as Toothache Plant, is a plant species that belongs to the dill family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which provide relief from toothache pain and other oral health issues. The health benefits of Acmella filipes var. parvifolia include pain relief, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
